notes.title: New game from Elden Pixels coming Feb 29!
notes.content:
Hello you lovely people!

Thank you all for being fans of the games we've created! Without your support we wouldn't be here and be able to continue making games. It really means a lot!

We wanted to take the opportunity to announce that our next game will be the narrative adventure called A Void Hope and it'll release February 29 on Steam, Switch and GOG.

A Void Hope takes you on an atmospheric narrative adventure to find a cure for a collapsed city. Follow the story of a tormented couple as they try to decipher reality from nightmares and evade the shadowy threats lurking in the dark.
 Solve puzzles and find items to progress
 Avoid combat and embrace exploration
 Uncover the mystical story
 An evocative soundtrack by synthwave mastermind Waveshaper
Here’s the freshly made release date trailer:
[previewyoutube=HB6M_C-dz4U;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438090/A_Void_Hope/

Although a bit different, this game is made by the same team behind our other titles and the reason we wanted to share these news is because we definitely think you can appreciate A Void Hope.

Thanks everyone!

Elden Pixels
